rests.title: Three against four — Shift four notes to every possible kind of meeting
notes: All three and all four notes remain. At offset zero the voices meet at slot one. Seven notes occupy six distinct slots.
The four-note voice moves one slot forward. Its meeting with Three is now at slot five; seven notes still occupy six slots.
Moving Four two slots puts the meeting at slot nine. The shared slot moves, but it never merges the two voices into one note.
